concepts.name: Object, block, and file storage
concepts.description: Amazon S3 provides object storage, Amazon EBS provides block storage for compute, and Amazon EFS or Amazon FSx provide managed file systems.

concepts.name: EBS SSD and HDD performance
concepts.description: EBS SSD volumes such as gp3 and io2 are optimized for transactional IOPS, while st1 and sc1 HDD volumes target large sequential throughput workloads.

concepts.name: Hybrid storage and transfer
concepts.description: AWS DataSync accelerates online data movement, Storage Gateway exposes hybrid storage interfaces, and Snow Family devices support large offline or edge data-transfer scenarios.

concepts.name: EC2 instance families and workload fit
concepts.description: EC2 instance families balance compute, memory, storage, networking, and accelerator resources for different workload profiles.

concepts.name: Lambda memory, concurrency, and scaling
concepts.description: Lambda allocates CPU and other resources in proportion to configured memory, and concurrency controls how many function executions can run at the same time.

concepts.name: Batch, containers, and serverless compute
concepts.description: AWS Batch manages batch job scheduling, ECS and EKS orchestrate containers, Fargate runs containers without managing servers, and Lambda runs event-driven functions.

concepts.name: Relational, key-value, graph, document, and warehouse databases
concepts.description: AWS provides purpose-built databases such as RDS and Aurora for relational workloads, DynamoDB for key-value and document access, Neptune for graph relationships, and Redshift for analytics warehousing.

concepts.name: ElastiCache and DAX
concepts.description: Amazon ElastiCache provides general in-memory caching, while DynamoDB Accelerator is a DynamoDB-compatible cache designed for microsecond read access to DynamoDB data.

concepts.name: Read replicas, Aurora readers, and RDS Proxy
concepts.description: Read replicas and Aurora reader instances scale read traffic, while RDS Proxy primarily improves connection management and reuse.

concepts.name: CloudFront vs Global Accelerator
concepts.description: CloudFront is a content delivery network that caches and delivers HTTP content from edge locations, while Global Accelerator uses the AWS global network to improve availability and performance for TCP and UDP applications.

concepts.name: ALB, NLB, and GWLB
concepts.description: ALB provides Layer 7 HTTP routing, NLB provides high-performance Layer 4 TCP and UDP load balancing, and GWLB integrates fleets of network virtual appliances.

concepts.name: Direct Connect, VPN, Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink
concepts.description: Direct Connect provides dedicated connectivity, Site-to-Site VPN provides encrypted IPsec connectivity, Transit Gateway acts as a network transit hub, and PrivateLink exposes services privately through endpoints.

concepts.name: Kinesis, Data Firehose, and MSK
concepts.description: Kinesis Data Streams provides real-time streaming with application-controlled consumers, Data Firehose delivers streaming data to destinations with minimal management, and Amazon MSK provides managed Apache Kafka.

concepts.name: Glue, EMR, Athena, and Redshift
concepts.description: AWS Glue provides managed data integration and ETL, EMR runs big-data frameworks, Athena runs serverless SQL on data in S3, and Redshift provides a managed data warehouse.

concepts.name: DataSync, Storage Gateway, and Snow Family
concepts.description: DataSync moves data online between storage systems, Storage Gateway supports ongoing hybrid access patterns, and Snow Family devices move or process data where network transfer is impractical.

concepts.name: Scaling metrics and capacity signals
concepts.description: Use CPU, ALB RequestCountPerTarget, queue backlog per worker, and Lambda concurrency/throttles as workload-correlated scaling signals.

concepts.name: Database access patterns and capacity
concepts.description: Choose DynamoDB on-demand/provisioned and Aurora Serverless capacity from traffic predictability and access patterns.

concepts.name: Network topology, routing, and IP capacity
concepts.description: Plan CIDR capacity, avoid overlapping routed address space, inspect routes, and use scalable hub topologies.

concepts.name: Data lake governance, formats, and visualization
concepts.description: Use Lake Formation for lake permissions, Parquet for efficient analytical scans, Athena for SQL on S3, and Amazon Quick Sight for BI dashboards.
